lines.en: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service I received at your branch last week.
Not only was the product damaged, but the replacement arrived two weeks later than promised.
I would be grateful if you could look into this matter at your earliest convenience.
Were the situation not so serious, I would not have troubled you with this letter.
It is with great regret that I must inform you of my decision to cancel my membership.
What I find particularly disappointing is that nobody has replied to my previous three emails.
However polite a complaint letter may be, it should still state clearly what action is expected.
I trust that you will give this matter your immediate attention, as the delay has caused considerable inconvenience.
Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
It was not until I threatened to contact consumer protection that the company finally responded.
I am writing with regard to the invoice dated 3 March, which I believe contains an error.
Not only do I expect a full refund, but I also request a written explanation of how this error occurred.
Should the matter remain unresolved within fourteen days, I shall be forced to seek legal advice.
What I expect, at the very least, is an acknowledgment that the delay was unacceptable.
I would appreciate it if this letter could be forwarded to the department responsible for customer accounts.
